basis: First Solar’s April 28 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statement of operations reports Q1 2022 net sales of $367,040,000 versus $803,374,000 for Q1 2021, a 54.31% decline. Both figures come from the same GAAP net sales row. The prior-year figure sets the 95% threshold at $763,205,300. Gains on business sales appear separately in the statement.

coverage.detail: November 4, 2021, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release retained full-year 2021 net sales guidance of $2.875 billion to $3.1 billion. It gave no Q1 2022 sales range.

The November presentation also labeled the sales outlook as 2021 guidance. Management’s discussion of 2022 covered manufacturing, freight and margins without setting a ceiling on Q1 consolidated revenue.
March 1, 2022, immediately preceding earnings release. First Solar forecast $2.4 billion to $2.6 billion of net sales for full-year 2022. That range leaves Q1 sales undetermined.

Slide 13 of the March 1 call presentation gives the same annual sales range. On the call, CFO Alex Bradley discussed the expected improvement in earnings over the year and the possible Japan platform sale. He gave no numeric Q1 consolidated sales outlook.
The intervening April 1 Form 8-K reported director Kathryn Hollister’s decision to forgo re-election. It contained no financial update.
The April 12 joint announcement with Silicon Ranch quantified a 4 GW supply agreement. It gave no Q1 consolidated sales figure.
The April 13 Nevada Gold Mines announcement described 260 MW of modules for a facility scheduled for deployment in Q2 2023. It gave no Q1 2022 revenue estimate.
First Solar’s April 14 notice scheduled Q1 results for after market close on April 28. It disclosed no preliminary sales.
The April 25 joint announcement with Leeward quantified a 1 GW multiyear procurement agreement. It gave no Q1 consolidated revenue figure.

The April 28 release gives exact comparative net sales in thousands for the three months ended March 31, 2022 and March 31, 2021. The $540 million decrease in the narrative uses Q4 2021 as its comparison.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s Exhibit 99.1 carries an April 28, 2022 dateline, says First Solar announced results that day for the quarter ended March 31, and schedules the results call for 4:30 p.m. Eastern that afternoon. The April 14 advance notice independently confirms the planned release date.
